{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many converted customers
print(f'Number of converted customers: {len(converted_df)}')

# Check age distribution for converted customers
print('\nAge value counts for converted customers:')
print(converted_df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 (missing age)
# As per documentation, -1 means no age supplied
mean_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'\nMean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
